name: Pennsylvania State Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: PSW's top singles title, first awarded on the promotion's second broadcast when Lance Hawkins defeated Eric VanGlory.

name: New England Heritage Championship
epitaph: One of PSW's founding singles titles, named in the promotion's opening announcement; no title match survives in the read record.

name: Keystone Championship
epitaph: One of PSW's founding singles titles, named in the promotion's opening announcement; no title match survives in the read record.

name: Pennsylvania State Tag Team Championship
epitaph: PSW's tag title, named in the promotion's opening announcement; the read record's own tag match does not contest it.

name: Prime Time Championship
epitaph: A secondary singles title added after PSW's opening announcement, changing hands when Platinum Ro defeated Halo in an impromptu main event.
